artwork.abstract: Schönberg Family is a painting by Richard Gerstl, from 1907.\n\n

prompt: Create an Austrian Expressionist family portrait from 1907, oil on aged canvas, square image preserving a slightly taller original composition. Four people cluster tightly before a mottled yellow-green and dark emerald background. At upper center stands a tall, balding man in a loosely rendered white shirt, his reddish face elongated. At upper left, slightly lower, a woman with dark hair piled high wears a deep navy patterned dress. In front center sits a pale blond child in a white garment; at right another child with reddish hair wears a salmon-pink dress. Their faces are rough, asymmetrical, and partially dissolved into thick strokes. Heavy impasto, scratched lines, muddy violet shadows, yellow ochre highlights, uneven old varnish.
